constructed_controls.scope: Exact pre-change immutable/fill-body oracles; unknown and nested fields; all root route kinds; rules, terminals, stackup and nets; unchanged inputs and detached output; explicit identity seam plus separate unmocked shared route/net identity checks.

known_limits: Only parsed plain-list/string ASTs are covered; arbitrary mutable subclasses or custom copy hooks are outside this helper contract.
The private shallow intermediate can share retained nodes temporarily; safety depends on both public callers retaining the final deepcopy before editing or returning data.
Tests and static review do not establish Native routing correctness, performance improvement, current runtime qualification or GUI support. Existing failed051/052 results remain unchanged.
reviewed_scope: _without_derived_fill makes a shallow root and root-zone projection, removing only direct DERIVED_ZONE children of root zones. Unknown root/footprint/zone fields, nested fill-looking fields and original zone intent remain retained.
immutable removes only root ROUTES and deepcopies the retained projection before returning. Its public result remains detached from original input.

transplant_fill retains the existing route/net identity check before projection, deepcopies retained original data and separately deepcopies new fill by matching original zone UUID. Source routes and non-fill intent remain original; missing source zones still refuse.

reviewer_scope.test_author: this reviewer; test self-review is not independent

verdict: No material blocker found in the reviewed plain-AST projection change.
